title: messages lens: read-only email thread pane
description: Selecting a thread in the email list opens it in the right pane read-only: subject header, then each message as an email card (sender, date, body) newest at the bottom, per the design's email card style.
design: renderer/src/lenses/messages/thread/: ThreadPane.tsx (useQuery mail.getThread), EmailCard.tsx. Body rendering: sanitize HTML with DOMPurify (no scripts, no forms, remote images allowed but loaded with referrerpolicy no-referrer), render inside a shadow root (EmailBody.tsx) so email CSS can't leak into the app; dark-mode friendly default text color, links open externally via shell.openExternal through a preload 'openExternal' (http/https only). Plain text bodies rendered as pre-wrap text with links autolinked. Empty state when nothing selected. No reply/archive/mark-read (later beads). Tests: sanitizer strips script/onerror, plain-text rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking a fixture row shows its messages with sanitized HTML rendered and isolated styles; links open in the default browser; nothing selected shows the empty state; typecheck/test/build pass.

title: messages lens: toolbar segments and email inbox list
description: The Messages lens per the Figma frame: pane with toolbar (All, Text, Email, Slack, Discord segments + search button), Email selected by default, showing the merged Gmail INBOX as message rows with infinite scroll.
design: renderer/src/lenses/messages/: MessagesLens.tsx (2-up: list pane 377px + detail pane), MessagesToolbar.tsx (SegmentGroup; Email default; Text/Slack/Discord/All render an empty state 'Coming soon' for now; search button inert), ThreadList.tsx built on a reusable InfiniteList primitive (ui/InfiniteList.tsx: owns load-more-near-end + loading/end states), MessageRow.tsx (Avatar with email source badge, sender name, subject-or-snippet preview line, relative time like 1h/3h/Sun/Wed per design, unread = bolder name), hooks useInboxThreads (react-query useInfiniteQuery over mail.listThreads label INBOX) and useSelectedThread. States: loading skeleton rows, empty ('Inbox is clear'), signed out (no accounts -> 'Sign in to Gmail in Psymail' hint), partial (an account unreachable/auth_expired -> small banner). Pinned people row from the design is out of scope (later bead). Tests: relative time formatting, row rendering from fixture data.
acceptance_criteria: With MOKI_FIXTURES=1 the app opens on Messages > Email showing fixture rows matching the Figma row anatomy; scrolling loads more; with real accounts it shows the live Gmail inbox; selecting a row highlights it; typecheck/test/build pass.
notes: Figma has no Email-segment, empty or loading frames and no row selected/hover state: use Selection · lit for the selected row, and keep empty/loading states quiet (icon + one line) per spec States section. Email badge = amber #FFC46B mail glyph.

title: helper: gmail client for label thread lists and thread detail
description: Thin Gmail REST client in the helper: list threads for a label merged across accounts, and fetch one thread's messages. Label scheme mirrors psymail-mini (inbox = INBOX; bundles psymail/<name>).
design: MokiHelperCore/Mail/: GmailClient (URLSession; users.labels.list to resolve label names -> ids per account, cached; users.threads.list?labelIds=..&maxResults=30&pageToken; users.threads.get?format=metadata for list rows (From, Subject, Date headers + snippet + labelIds) fetched with bounded concurrency 8; users.threads.get?format=full for detail). MailService.listThreads(label:String, cursor:[address:pageToken]?) -> {threads:[ThreadSummary], next: cursor?, unreachable:[address], authExpired:[address]} merged newest-first across accounts (pattern from psymail-mini MailSource.MailPage). ThreadSummary {id, account, from:{name,address}, subject, snippet, date ISO8601, unread, messageCount, labelIds}. ThreadDetail {id, account, subject, messages:[{id, from, to, cc, date, html, text, isFromMe}]} with body chosen html>plain, base64url decoded, charset handled. RPC: 'mail.listThreads' {label:'INBOX', cursor?}, 'mail.getThread' {account, id}. Fixture mode env MOKI_FIXTURES=1 serves canned threads (12 rows across 2 accounts incl. one HTML email) with no network so UI work and screenshots don't need sign-in. Mirror the shapes as TS types in packages/protocol (method map). Tests: header parsing, base64url/charset decode, merge ordering, fixture mode.
acceptance_criteria: MOKI_FIXTURES=1 mail.listThreads returns fixture rows; against real accounts it returns the INBOX newest-first with names, subjects, snippets; mail.getThread returns decoded HTML for an HTML email; protocol types match; swift test + pnpm typecheck pass.

title: helper: google accounts reusing psymail-mini oauth and tokens
description: The helper can list signed-in Google accounts and mint access tokens, reusing psymail-mini's Desktop OAuth client and its stored refresh tokens so no new sign-in is needed.
design: MokiHelperCore/Google/: OAuthClientConfig loads GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET from (1) env MOKI_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, (2) ~/dev/psymail-mini/Config/Secrets.xcconfig parsed as 'KEY = value' lines (path overridable by MOKI_PSYMAIL_SECRETS). TokenSource: reads refresh tokens JSON {address: token} from Moki's own file ~/Library/Application Support/Moki/google-tokens.json (0600) and imports from psymail-mini's file: search ~/Library/Containers/*/Data/Library/Application Support/PsymailMini/tokens.json and ~/Library/Application Support/PsymailMini/tokens.json; copies found tokens into Moki's file once (never writes psymail's). AccessTokenCache actor: refresh via POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token, cache until expiry-60s; invalid_grant => AppError code 'auth_expired'. Profile via https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v2/userinfo (name, picture). RPC: 'accounts.list' -> [{address, name?, photoURL?, status: 'ok'|'auth_expired'}]. Never log or return tokens. Sign-in for new accounts is out of scope (later bead). Tests: xcconfig parsing, token file import/merge, refresh request building with a stubbed URLProtocol.
acceptance_criteria: With psymail-mini signed in, 'accounts.list' over stdio returns the user's Gmail accounts with status ok; with no tokens it returns []; tokens never appear in stdout/stderr; swift test passes.

title: helper bridge: spawn helper from main, typed rpc to renderer
description: Electron main spawns the Swift helper, speaks JSON-RPC to it, and exposes a typed, minimal API to the renderer through the preload.
design: packages/protocol: RPC method map type { 'helper.ping': {params: void; result: {ok:boolean; version:string}} , ...} plus notification map; shared error shape {code, message}. apps/desktop/src/main/helper/: HelperProcess (spawn helper binary: dev = helper/.build/debug/moki-helper, built via 'swift build' in a predev script; prod path later), line-buffered stdout parser, pending-request map with per-call timeout (15s), restart with backoff on exit, stderr piped to main log. ipcMain.handle('rpc', (method, params)) forwards; notifications forwarded to renderer via webContents.send('rpc:notify'). Preload: contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('moki', { call<M>(method, params), on(event, cb) }) typed from protocol. Renderer hook useRpcQuery built on @tanstack/react-query. Unit tests for the line parser and request/response matching with a fake child process. Show helper status (ok / down) in the inspector footer in dev.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm dev builds the helper and launches the app; renderer calls helper.ping and shows version; killing the helper process recovers within a few seconds; tests cover parser + matching.
notes: from round-1 taste review: preload currently exposes a bespoke ping — replace with window.moki.call/on typed from protocol; declare helper.ping in packages/protocol and drop the MokiProtocolHello placeholder

Default lens = messages. Routing: simple state in a ShellProvider (createProvider pattern), no router library. Electron drag region on the top strip (-webkit-app-region: drag; buttons no-drag). Collapsed inspector = 32px rail per spec.

title: design tokens and ui primitives from figma
description: Turn docs/design/messages-brief.md into CSS custom properties and a small primitives layer in the renderer so every lens builds from the same parts.
design: apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/ui/: tokens.css (colors, radii, spacing, type scale, glass effects as CSS variables, dark only; body backdrop gradient from the brief), font Plus Jakarta Sans via @fontsource/plus-jakarta-sans (400/500/600/700) and the six Lenses/* text styles from the brief as classes or Text props. Primitives, each a small component extending native element props: Icon (Lucide via lucide-react; 16px icons use strokeWidth 2.625 to match Figma 1.75px, round caps — see brief for the name mapping), Avatar (initials + gradient seeded by name, optional source badge slot), IconButton (36px), Segment + SegmentGroup (icon segments as in the Messages toolbar), GlassPane (rounded pane with glass fill/blur), Text (size/weight/tone shorthand props), Row (generic list row with leading/trailing slots). A /dev route or storybook-lite page 'Primitives' rendering each one, reachable in dev only. Vitest + @testing-library/react tests for Avatar initials/gradient determinism and SegmentGroup selection. Selection: implement the shared 'Selection · lit' style (brief §6) as a .selected-lit class used by sidebar rows, segments and list rows.
acceptance_criteria: Primitives page renders every primitive; Avatar gives the same gradient for the same name; tokens match the brief's hex values; typecheck/test/build pass.
notes: from round-1 taste review: App.tsx has inline raw-hex styles and system-ui — replace with tokens.css + Plus Jakarta Sans

title: scaffold swift helper with stdio json-rpc
description: A SwiftPM executable 'moki-helper' in helper/ that the Electron main process will spawn. Speaks newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdin/stdout; logs only to stderr.
design: helper/Package.swift (swift-tools 6.0, macOS 15+, targets: MokiHelperCore library, moki-helper executable, MokiHelperCoreTests). Core: RPCServer reading lines from stdin, decoding {jsonrpc,id,method,params}, dispatching to a registry [String: Handler] where Handler is (JSONValue params) async throws -> Encodable; writes one JSON line per response; errors map to JSON-RPC error objects (-32601 method not found, -32602 invalid params, -32000 app error with data.code string like 'auth_expired'). Writes must be serialized (actor). Supports server->client notifications {method, params} without id via a Notifier. Built-in methods: 'helper.ping' -> {ok:true, version}. Handlers registered from main.swift so later features add a file + one registration line. Tests: dispatch of ping, unknown method error, malformed JSON error, using an in-memory line transport.
acceptance_criteria: cd helper && swift build && swift test pass; echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"helper.ping"}' | swift run moki-helper prints a single JSON line with result.ok true; nothing but JSON-RPC lines goes to stdout.
notes:
review: RPCServer.run awaits each request before reading the next line — slow handlers serialize everything; dispatch each line in its own Task
round: 1 round (+1 relaunch after opencode external_directory refusal), accepted with 2 small orchestrator fixes
close_reason: helper scaffold landed; review added concurrent dispatch + silent unknown-method notifications

Window: 1600x980 default, min 1100x700, titleBarStyle hiddenInset with trafficLightPosition {x:20,y:20}, backgroundColor #0b0b14, vibrancy none, contextIsolation true, nodeIntegration false, sandbox true. Renderer shows 'moki' text for now. Pin deps to current stable majors: electron, electron-vite, vite, react 19, typescript, vitest. One vitest smoke test in packages/protocol. .gitignore: node_modules, out, dist, .tmp, helper/.build. verify.steps.sh: step typecheck 'pnpm -s typecheck'; step test 'pnpm -s test'; step build 'pnpm -s build' (electron-vite build, no packaging). Leave the existing probe/drain lines' structure intact but replace the 'false' placeholders.
